QUOTE: If the standard functions are not available, the default is the `platform_calloc_uninit` stub in `platform.c:25-30`, which always returns NULL. Until a real allocator is installed, every allocation fails.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the uninitialised calloc stub returns NULL, but it never says the uninitialised free does nothing, and it frames the stub as conditional on missing standard functions.
